I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

Tobias logged it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27), and Pree is in that channel. He wrote that West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he "flagged it on ticket #8841 for support."

He called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I think it's the same account: a note in GBrain from January 2026 calls Marrow Fieldworks a dealer account that was changing hands on 5 Jan. But that's an inference, so my reply suggests Pree check with Tobias before the customer call. A ticket number is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share with someone on the account's team.
